verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs say it can "automate tasks and workflows," and the REST API lists webhooks, which could drive event-based automation through external code. Nothing in the evidence shows scheduled or recurring triggers, so this only glancingly covers the story. Missing for 10: documented schedule/calendar-based or recurring triggers, built-in automation rule docs, examples of routine team-work workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
